name: AWS S3 Storage
description: Industry-standard object storage with AWS S3 — file uploads, presigned URLs, and public/private buckets.

requiredSecrets.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
requiredSecrets.reason: AWS IAM access key ID with S3 permissions

postInstallNotes:
1. Create an IAM user with `AmazonS3FullAccess` (or a scoped policy) and generate access keys.
2. Create an S3 bucket in the AWS console. Configure CORS if you're uploading from a browser.
3. Use `getPresignedUploadUrl` to generate a time-limited upload URL for direct client-side uploads.
